title: Prove closure-bound activation in a disposable sandbox
goal: After T006 has integrated the exact reviewed T001/T002 source and created the immutable activation-source artifact, prove the managed Nix/NixOS build-and-activation contract end to end inside an exclusively reserved disposable non-production sandbox using only that leased artifact: realize an exact closure, activate only that approved closure, read it back independently, prove denied paths are effect-free and prove rollback without reading the live Heim-PC Git object store or touching the productive Heim-PC.

approval.note: Runtime mutation is authorized only inside the exclusively reserved disposable activation sandbox and only after T006 is terminal. Source acquisition is restricted to the separately leased immutable artifact.heim-pc.nixos-activation-source; /home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git, mutable worktrees, moving branches, mutable locks and unpinned remote sources are outside T004 authority and must not be read for build or activation. Productive Heim-PC activation, boot state, production storage, EFI, Secure-Boot, firmware and reboot remain forbidden.

acceptance.assertion: Before any build/runtime effect, T006 is terminal and independently reviewed, and T004 binds the exact T006 integration commit/tree plus its terminal source-artifact manifest and receipt. Any different source identity or incomplete T006 evidence fails closed.

Before source bytes are read, T004 holds the artifact.heim-pc.nixos-activation-source read claim materialized as the exact artifact path lease. Independent re-hash verifies the content-addressed artifact and manifest bind Git commit/tree, content digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity exactly to T006 evidence.

Build and activation source acquisition read only the leased immutable T006 artifact. T004 has no /home/alex/repos/heim-pc/.git lease and no live source-path lease; any attempted read or reevaluation from the Git object store, mutable checkout, branch, mutable lock or unpinned remote fails closed before runtime effect.

Before any runtime effect, the run holds the exclusive service.heim-pc-nixos-activation-sandbox claim and independently proves that the target is disposable and isolated from productive Heim-PC runtime, production storage, EFI, firmware and persistent boot state.

Using only the verified T006 content-addressed source artifact and receipt-bound inputs, a managed sandbox build realizes an immutable NixOS system closure and emits a receipt binding exact source commit/tree, artifact digest, Control Release Set, effect class and closure.

Sandbox activation consumes only the reviewed managed-build receipt bound to the exact source artifact digest, source revision, immutable closure, sandbox target and Activation effect class; mutable source, branch names or caller-supplied closure strings alone cannot authorize activation.

Missing, stale, mismatched or unauthorized T006/artifact/review/receipt/target authority is rejected before runtime mutation, and evidence proves the denied path leaves sandbox activation state unchanged.
Independent live readback after authorized sandbox activation proves the running/booted system closure exactly equals the approved closure from the bound receipt.

Observed activation performs no Git, branch, lock or remote-input reevaluation after the reviewed build receipt is fixed; runtime evidence demonstrates closure selection remains receipt-bound to the T006 source artifact.
Inside the same disposable sandbox, rollback consumes the receipt-bound prior closure/recovery path and independent readback proves the expected rollback closure without mutable-source reevaluation.

This task terminates without productive nixos-rebuild switch, productive boot activation, production storage/EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, Heim-PC reboot or any equivalent production cutover effect.
The exact source-artifact, sandbox build, activation, readback, denied-path and rollback evidence is independently reviewed before T004 is considered terminal.
